definitions.week: Source stores only a string YYYY-WW (2026-32 through 2026-44). No explicit ISO/Monday convention or timezone in workbook. Calendar dates are the ISO-week interpretation matching requested Monday start dates; retained raw keys allow verification against extraction code.
definitions.ordered_units: Ordered product units, not paid/delivered/redemption units and not card visits.
definitions.revenue: Sum of ordered amounts, not profit. Currency is not specified in workbook header; Russian-ruble context comes from source account, not an explicit cell label.
definitions.missing_sku_rows: Absent SKU-week rows remain null in before/after fields. For arithmetic decomposition of observed workbook totals only, absence contributes zero to that period sum; this does not prove actual zero sales for an omitted SKU.
definitions.full_weeks: Six requested weeks lie fully within the supplied extraction window under ISO-week interpretation. First week2026-32 and final2026-44 not used.

comparisons.reconciliation: all SKU contributions sum exactly to weekly total change
